name: Tour a system map
visual_intent: Explain a system part by part on one map: the camera frames each part on its spoken name, follows anything that travels between parts, and pulls back to the whole at the end.

parameters.name: drift
parameters.description: Scale reached while holding a stop

parameters.name: start
parameters.description: overview or first (start framed on the first stop)

parameters.name: pullBack
parameters.description: Time of the closing pull-back to the whole canvas

timeline_requirements.gsap_instance: Timeline passed to Studio.build(builder) (registered as window.__timelines['root'])
timeline_requirements.timing_anchors: Cue map (Studio.cues) or word times (Studio.cues.fromWords); snap each move to the word it illustrates

fallbacks: Studio.comp.progression when the parts fit on one stage; SP.camera for a single push-in.

validation.evidence: Runtime checks tests/studio-runtime/explain-devices.html and frame review of tests/reference-derived/explain-tour-progression/index.html (0 errors, 0 warnings, contact sheet inspected) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-11-28. Not rendered through HyperFrames on the M2.
